caption:
Healthier - Hakka Noodles
meal prep friendly | side dish recipe 
the trick is to add in the equal amount of cabbage to noodles..
feeling super healthy? add in the double cabbage ratio to noodles!

Macros:
C: 51 | F: 4 | P: 10
Calories: 274 per serve
Serves 3 or 2 hungry adults :) 

Ingredients: 

1 tsp chilli oil
1 - 2 greens of the spring onion
1 tbsp minced garlic
100 grams mushroom
1 carrot, thinly sliced
150 grams cabbage, shredded thin, (use as much as the noodles you are adding) 
1 capsicum, i use a mix of all green and red
150 grams whole wheat hakka noodles, i use the soak and use ones
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp chilli vinegar
1 tbsp green chilli sauce, personal favorite but you can skip if you dont have it on hand 

pro tip: feel free to add more soy or chilli sauce to the noodles depending on your personal preference :) 

this recipe pairs amazing with my sticky asian chicken meatballs that adds 35 grams of protein per serve! 
Recipe for those out tomorrow :)
